content.content: clause by clause: no element of wzsxvmvw contradicts or overrides any element of ruqsmuxz, rwonulnq, ozxnxzus, pposortu, pltovtuo or kwxutvpw, and what those nodes decide stays in force under wzsxvmvw - traversal order in both directions and its wrap, a visible focus emphasis on the focused node, zoom about the viewport centre, stability of pan, zoom and selection across panel focus changes, and activation of an id listed in one of the detail panel's relationship sections, which is a pointer click on that id or Enter or Space on it and which selects the node the id names and shows that node's detail; the centring move wzsxvmvw puts behind such an activation takes that activation as kwxutvpw defines it and is stated as its consequence, so wzsxvmvw must neither restate, narrow nor override what an activation is or which node it selects - the selection and the detail stay kwxutvpw's and ltrnmrsr's, and the axis and limit terms of the centring rule stay wzsxvmvw's own; fail where the rule does not reach a move that begins at such an activation, where it settles activation or its selected node anew, where it states that trigger incompatibly with kwxutvpw, or on any contradicting or overriding element; fail naming the element of wzsxvmvw and the prerequisite element at issue
content.rationale: both endpoints are inline statements read as their own form: the decision is an inline requirement, the five earlier prerequisites are requirement sentences and a visual-spec element, and kwxutvpw is inline prose, so the earlier edges sit in the default cell while the added edge sits in the gate cell, which is the same gate form - the default cell stays flagged for a matrix entry; the use is a fan-out over six prerequisites that one clause-by-clause non-violation review decides, so the edge set is gated by amending this criterion rather than by a second evaluation, since one subject checked against one set of inline prerequisites is one review and a second review of the same subject would either restate this one or drift from it; the added clause cites kwxutvpw for what an activation is and which node it selects instead of restating that definition, because the inputs and the selected node are kwxutvpw's to settle and this edge adds only a consequence of them - a criterion carrying its own copy of the definition would track kwxutvpw's wording, fail under its rewording, and could not tell a re-defined activation from a cited one
